modules.responsibility: Release 56 PURE kernel for the capital axis. Owns three calculations that did not previously exist and NO second opinion about anything that did: (1) the CASH DEPLOYMENT LADDER in two modes that are never blurred - CASH_ONLY_BUYS_NO_SALES (cash is a hard ceiling; a rung larger than the cash on hand reports its shortfall as unfunded) and REDEPLOYMENT_BUYS_AND_SALES (the allocator's own two-leg path, funded by cash AND sales); (2) the PAYBACK HORIZON - switch cost divided by the per-horizon utility gain, the number the transition path implied and never stated; (3) the REALISED EXCESS DECOMPOSITION into cash drag (quoting the desk's own formula), transaction cost drag and an explicitly-named UNEXPLAINED residual that is never relabelled selection alpha. The objective, the caps, the covariance scaling and the transaction-cost arithmetic are IMPORTED from engine.zero_base_allocator, so every ladder point is a blend of weight vectors the allocator already produced and nothing here can propose a portfolio the allocator would refuse. Cash wins a rung by name whenever the net-of-cost gain is not positive or the eligible targets cannot absorb the money.
modules.notes: Pure: no I/O, no clock, no randomness, no network, no database. Creates no signal, target, proposal, decision, order or fill.

modules.responsibility: Release 56 PURE kernel for FORWARD PAPER PORTFOLIO CHALLENGERS. Release 46 competes SIGNALS forward; this competes PORTFOLIOS. Builds the immutable inception record (weights, cash, PIT input identity, entry cost model, named valuation owner, record hash over that body) and accrues its forward P&L. THE rule the file exists to enforce: no function will read a bar dated on or before the inception session, so there is no code path to hindsight. It does not rebalance (a rebalance is a decision nobody took) and it does not manufacture prices (a session where under 95% of invested weight has a real bar is reported UNCOVERED and is not scored). compare_on_common_window intersects two books' calendars so an excess is always measured on equal time; the leaderboard ranks evidence maturity before measured edge.
modules.notes: Not a second P&L owner: the operational book's authoritative NAV remains api.paper_trading_desk.book_nav and each challenger names the owner that values it.

modules.responsibility: Release 56 composition and read owner of the CASH DEPLOYMENT FRONTIER and the INCUMBENT OPPORTUNITY COST. Owns no mathematics: it builds the zero-base input contract ONCE, runs the allocator ONCE, derives the horizon covariance through the allocator's own helper, and hands all of it to engine.alpha_capital_frontier. Publishes both ladders (cash-only and redeployment), the incumbent opportunity cost with its payback horizon, and TWO permanently-labelled lanes: the RESEARCH utility lane (which has a forecast and is therefore evidence) and the GOVERNED lane (which has no calibrated expected return and says so).

modules.responsibility: Release 56 ONE canonical registry of ECONOMICALLY DISTINCT alpha families. Two permanently-distinguishable halves: a FROZEN CATALOGUE of citations (release, document, that release's own published figures, and the named reopen_condition for every closed family; nulls where a release published nothing) and a LIVE COMPOSITION from api.prospective_tournament, api.pnl_opportunity_frontier, api.opportunity_frontier and api.universe_scoring. Also owns the ASSET-CLASS READINESS table (DATA_READY / RESEARCH_READY / FORWARD_SHADOW_READY / NOT_READY / BLOCKED) and the EXPERIMENT QUEUE ranked by EXPECTED INFORMATION VALUE, which rejects by name any experiment that re-tests an EXHAUSTED family without new information.

modules.responsibility: Release 56 composition, freeze and read owner of the FORWARD PAPER PORTFOLIO CHALLENGERS: the zero-base target, the implementable target, the governed score lane (equal-weight top-25 on the approved model's own ranking), the incumbent book, all-cash and passive SPY. Freezing is an EXPLICIT call - no GET writes - and is first-write-wins per (challenger, inception session); a record is never rewritten and never backfilled. modules.responsibility: Release 56 ONE read model behind the operator's ALPHA & CAPITAL surface. Answers eight questions in the order a portfolio manager asks them by composing owners that already published the facts (api.capital_pool, api.cash_deployment_frontier, api.alpha_opportunity_registry, api.shadow_portfolio_evidence, api.prospective_tournament, api.research_agent, api.forward_evidence, api.paper_trading_desk). It owns exactly ONE calculation of its own - the LIMITER RANKING - and it ranks facts those owners measured: severity band first, then measured impact in points of realised excess. The SCOREBOARD carries a WINDOW on every row, because rows on different clocks are not comparable and saying so is the summary's job.
